title: Chapter 77: Night Flight 2
content:
Chapter 77

Night Flight 2

It used to be that people came to him asking what to do. Now, he was the one asking others, completely lost, with no idea where to turn. And there wasn't a single soul who could give him an answer.

Suddenly, a tiny prick of pain flared at the side of Wei Wuxian’s neck—like the sting of an impossibly slender needle. A wave of numbness instantly washed through him. His mind had been so scrambled, his guard so completely down, that by the time he realized something was wrong, his body was already tipping sideways onto the stone bed. He tried to raise an arm, but before he could even lift it halfway, it dropped dead against the slab. He was paralyzed from the neck down.

Eyes rimmed in red, Wen Qing slowly pulled her right hand back. "...I'm sorry."

Under normal circumstances, she wouldn't have stood a chance of landing a needle on him, but Wei Wuxian had been completely defenseless. The puncture hit deep, shocking his scattered thoughts into a chilling stillness. His throat hitched, his Adam's apple bobbing before he managed to force out, "What the hell are you doing?"

Wen Qing and Wen Ning exchanged a solemn glance. Stepping up side-by-side before him, they bowed in deep, formal unison.

The sight made a surge of frantic panic claw at Wei Wuxian’s chest. "What are you doing?! What is this?!"

Wen Qing said evenly, "When you woke up, we were just finishing our discussion. It's settled."

"Settled what?! Cut the crap! Pull the needle out and let me go!"

Wen Ning slowly pushed himself up from the floor, keeping his chin tucked low. "Jiejie and I... we made up our minds. We're going to Koi Tower. To surrender."

"Surrender?!" Wei Wuxian gasped, stunned. "Surrender what? Turn yourselves in? Offer yourselves up on a silver platter?!"

Wen Qing rubbed her swollen eyes, her voice forced into a brittle, calm facade. "Pretty much. While you were out cold these past few days, the Lanling Jin Sect sent runners to the foot of the mountain with an ultimatum."

"What ultimatum?! Stop speaking in riddles! Tell me the whole thing, right now!"

Wen Qing replied, "Lanling Jin demands accountability. And that means handing over the two ringleaders of the Wen remnants. Especially the Ghost General."

Wen Qing replied evenly, "Whatever happens to him, he brought it on himself."

No. It wasn't Wen Ning who brought it on himself. It was Wei Wuxian.

Wen Qing continued, "Besides, strictly speaking, we should have been dead a long time ago. These past few months... we consider them borrowed time."
